artifacts.text:
# Revised capacity assessment

The measured site-B corridor is 700 mm. The 900 mm unit is NOT admissible at site B; site A remains admissible. The baseline 1200 mm assumption is superseded.

# Revised cost model (reworked on the current basis)

The accepted capacity-v2 result excludes the 900 mm unit at site B. The cost model now uses the 700 mm-compatible unit; the baseline cost line is not reused.

# Integrated deployment decision

This package is consistent with the accepted capacity-v2 and cost-v2 results: the measured 700 mm site-B corridor excludes the 900 mm unit, and the revised cost model uses the compatible unit. The baseline capacity/cost results are historical and are not part of the accepted package.
